m: Chips: oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into chips, toss with oil and salt, roast 35 to 40 minutes.
Slice the breasts in half horizontally so they cook evenly. Set up flour, beaten egg and crumbs.
Crumb every piece. Do the GF ones first in their own flour, egg and crumbs.
Shallow-fry 3 minutes a side until golden. Move to a lined tray.
Napoli: passata with oregano and salt. Spoon over each schnitzel, top with ham and mozzarella.
Bake 10 minutes until bubbling. Serve with chips and a simple lettuce, cucumber and lemon salad.
l: Slice the parma into strips and pack with salad. Reheat in the oven or air fryer, never the microwave, to keep it crunchy.
g: GF flour and breadcrumbs, crumbed first and fried in fresh oil or a separate pan. Check the ham.
